notes: INTENT: an LLM call site with no rate limit and no token ceiling is the classic denial-of-wallet — one loop empties the account overnight, with no breach involved. Because a limiter could live at the edge or in middleware this pass does not follow, these are weak-evidence findings (needs-review), NOT confirmed: the harness still requires them (recall gate applies to all planted findings, not only confirmed ones). The route is deliberately authenticated and body-validated so the ONLY findings are the two LLM ones — a grader change that starts flagging the auth/validation would surface as an unexpected finding (precision drop). The fixed variant adds an Upstash rate limit and max_tokens, so it must be silent.
